additional_info.subject: AW: ID0431458-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / R0 170002836]Communication error CRM:02681000338
additional_info.body:
Hello, this is the information from the customer:
Please forward the history and frequency of communication errors for charging station 8 (SN 170002836) to the appropriate department. They are just the same error, just at different times, and they disappear on their own after a few minutes or a few hours. Until now, I assumed this error would disappear after the update. But unfortunately, it persists. Every time it occurs, the power drops to exactly 18-19 kW.
You will also notice from the history that charging station 7 (SN 170002835) displays the error message much less frequently, but also displays it. (Approx. 80% for charging station 8?)
It seems to be related to something other than the update. I mentioned this message a few times before, but now, in a compiled form, it seems clearer.
Best Regards,
Ralph Lindner
